pending_interview.question: You are given a list of log entries, where each entry is a string in the format "user_id action timestamp" (e.g., "u42 login 1001"). Write a function that, given this list and a time window of length W, returns the user ID who performed the most distinct actions within any contiguous window of time of length W. If there is a tie, return any one of the tied users. Describe your approach, its time complexity (Big-O notation for how runtime scales with input size), and any tradeoffs you made.
